conversations.prompt:
This fails to remove the control chars added by zsh.

console.log(combinedData, cleanedData) logs:

[Jko@MacBook-Pro-5 Junior % [K[?2004h 
Jko@MacBook-Pro-5 Junior % ?2004h

Fix this and use the same goal
conversations.answer: ChatGPTThe reason for the failure is due to the regex not matching the control characters from zsh correctly.The control character [?2004h is different from ^[[2004h. In the former, ^[ is a visual representation of the Escape character ESC, which in regex is represented as \x1B.I'll modify the regex to catch this control sequence:[CODE_BLOCK_0]The regex change (\x1B\[\?2004h|\x1B\[\?2004l) will correctly match the control sequences you provided.
